title: `nvs agent init` installs for the agent found in the environment, and adds a check-on-edit hook where the agent's tool runs a plain command after an edit
scope:
which agents `nvs agent init` knows and how it finds the one that runs it, what each one gets beside the
`AGENTS.md` stanza, the hooks it merges into Claude Code's and Cursor's settings, and `nvs agent hook`,
the command those hooks run. What a pointer may say is [0167](0167.md)'s, and how a re-run tells an
upgrade from an edit is [0256](0256.md)'s; both are unchanged.
validatedBy:
`crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs` — the `init_*` cases, `no_hooks_removes_each_hook_and_check_names_a_missing_one`
and the five `the_hook_*`, `the_claude_code_hook_*` and `the_cursor_hook_*` cases.

summary.headline: Claude Code and Cursor check each Novis file they edit
summary.body:
`nvs agent init` finds the coding agent that runs it and writes what that agent needs. For Claude
Code and Cursor it also adds a hook. After the agent edits a `.nvs` file, the hook runs `nvs check`
on it and shows the agent the errors. `nvs agent init --no-hooks` removes the hooks.
